name: flatten
description: Flattens nested arrays to any depth, with helpers for shallow, deep, and infinite flattening.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to reduce nested array structures into a single-level array, such as when combining results from nested map operations or normalizing tree-shaped data.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: How many levels deep to flatten (default: 1). Use Infinity for full depth.
